description: Full detail for one plugin by its STABLE plugin id (from SearchPlugins): what it includes (connectors, skills), its install state, any setup fields InstallPlugin needs (with required/secret flags), and the installed MCP servers backing it. Read this before installing a plugin with setup fields, and before uninstalling (to know the full scope you must disclose). Using a connector GetDynamicTools already lists does not need it. Read-only.

plugin_id.description: The stable plugin id from SearchPlugins.
